addTabs.helpIntro: Pick the tab that matches your situation. Each type feeds the assistant differently.
addTabs.helpWebsiteBody: For a business with a website. Yayra crawls pages (services, FAQ, pricing…) to answer visitors. Optional contacts are a fallback when crawl finds no Contact page.
addTabs.helpJobOverviewBody: Two use cases: candidate profile (CV, link for recruiters) or hiring campaign (job post, link for applicants). Each profile gets an AI presentation and a tracked link.
addTabs.helpJobCandidateBody: Candidate profile: skills + PDF CV. Yayra writes a pro presentation and creates a tracked link to share. Recruiters see the profile and can contact you.
addTabs.helpJobRecruitBody: Hiring campaign: role title, missions, requirements, benefits. Yayra writes an engaging job post and creates a tracked link to share. Candidates can ask questions and apply via the widget.

pricing.billingNote: Monthly billing in USD (Stripe). Change plan anytime from the dashboard after signup.

items.a: About 5 minutes: create an account, enter the URL of your site, the crawl and agent training will launch automatically.
Not by design: the agent only relies on the crawled content of your site. If he doesn't know, he offers human contact.

items.q: Can I use it without a developer?
items.a: Yes. Copy the widget script or tracked link from the dashboard. No technical skills required.

items.q: How do I integrate it into my site (WordPress, Next.js, React, etc.)?
items.a: Only one script to paste before </body>. Detailed guides for each framework on the Integration page — viewable even before creating an account.
French, English, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and German. The agent detects the visitor's language and responds in the same language.

items.q: Free vs Starter vs Pro — what's the difference?
items.a: Free: website + tracked link to share chat (social, QR). Starter: widget embedded on your site + logo. Pro: Jobs/Other profiles, WhatsApp/call/email contacts, advisor handoff and mobile app.
A Support page in the dashboard lets you message the team (reply by email). Agency customers get priority handling.
